kurzfassung: This episode features various listener-submitted horror stories involving unsettling encounters. Narratives include home intrusions, being followed, and dangerous situations with strangers. The stories are presented as firsthand accounts from the authors.
stichpunkte: An encounter involving a snowplowing tractor
An experience with a man who hunted the author
A creepy encounter at a workplace
An incident involving a late-night knock at a window
Being followed through the woods to a car
An account of being drugged and kidnapped
